-- stage functions (80 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "id"], ["__path", "name"]]}
SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

-- stage attributes (128 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "id"]]}
SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_id AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

-- stage calls (275 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "id"], ["__path", "callee"]]}
SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

-- stage arguments (1060 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "call", "position"]]}
SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,n.id,n.parent,n.edge_parent,n.ordinal,n.text,n.kind,n.line,n.parent_start,n.parent_end,n.parent_kind,n.ancestor_start,n.ancestor_end,n.ancestor_kind,n.name_start,n.name_end,n.name_kind,n.name_source,n.left_start,n.left_end,n.left_kind,n.right_start,n.right_end,n.right_kind,n.value_start,n.value_end,n.value_kind,n.type_start,n.type_end,n.type_kind,n.function_start,n.function_end,n.function_kind,n.arguments_start,n.arguments_end,n.arguments_kind,n.object_start,n.object_end,n.object_kind,n.object_source,n.attribute_source,n.parameters_start,n.parameters_end,n.parameters_kind,n.return_type_start,n.return_type_end,n.return_type_kind,n.name_id,n.left_id,n.right_id

-- stage keywords (348 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "call", "name"], ["__path", "value"]]}
SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_id AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_id JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_id

-- stage descendants (4 chars) {"reachability": {"roots": "SELECT __path,id,kind NOT IN ('module','block','expression_statement','argument_list','decorated_definition','type') AS expand FROM nodes", "syntax": "nodes"}}
null

-- stage assignments (336 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "target_text"], ["__path", "id"], ["__path", "value"]]}
SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_id LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

-- stage parameters (472 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "name"]]}
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_id AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

-- stage contexts (1862 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "id"], ["__path", "name"]]}
WITH RECURSIVE class_parents(__path,id,name,parent) AS (SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.name_source,own.cls FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.edge_parent WHERE n.kind='class_definition'), class_names(__path,id,name) AS (SELECT __path,id,name FROM class_parents WHERE parent IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.id,p.name||'.'||c.name FROM class_names p JOIN class_parents c ON c.__path=p.__path AND c.parent=p.id) SELECT f.*,coalesce(qualified.name,'') AS class_name,rx_matches(f.name,'_lazy$') OR f.name IN ('compile','lower','post_op','pre_op','preprocess') OR f.name='pending_pipeline_effects' OR rx_matches(f.name,'^apply_.*_effect$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes w 

-- stage body_nodes (127 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "node"], ["__path", "node", "fn"]]}
SELECT own.__path,own.top_fn AS fn,own.id AS node FROM ownership own JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=own.__path AND c.id=own.top_fn

-- stage callback_parameters (560 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "name"]]}
SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.id AS fn,p.name,k.name AS callback_kind,p.position FROM contexts c JOIN calls call ON call.__path=c.__path AND call.__start>=c.__start AND call.__end<=c.__end AND call.callee='CompiledStep' JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=call.__path AND k.call=call.id AND k.name IN ('post_op','post_op_with_refs') AND k.kind='identifier' JOIN functions nested ON nested.__path=c.__path AND nested.name=k.text AND nested.__start>c.__start AND nested.__end<=c.__end JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=nested.__path AND p.fn=nested.id WHERE p.position IN (1,2)

-- stage parameter_kinds (1512 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "name", "kind"]]}
SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'authority' AS kind FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE p.name IN ('txn','read_txn','write_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn') OR rx_matches(coalesce(ann.text,''),'\b(?:ReadTransaction|SyncDatabaseConnection|SyncSqlConnection|WriteTransaction)\b') UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'provider' FROM parameters p JOIN nodes ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation WHERE rx_matches(ann.text,'\b(?:CrossBranchQueryProvider|HybridSearchProvider|VectorCandidateProvider|VersionedLoweringProvider|VersionedStorageProvider)\b') UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,'runtime_value' FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN nodes a

-- stage string_values (664 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "__start", "__end"]]}
SELECT __path,__start,__end,value FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_strings_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_2) UNION SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,s.value FROM assignments a JOIN nodes stmt ON stmt.__path=a.__path AND stmt.id=a.parent JOIN nodes root ON root.__path=stmt.__path AND root.id=stmt.parent AND root.kind='module' JOIN (SELECT * FROM raw_strings_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_strings_2) s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.right_start AND s.__end=a.right_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=a.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text=a.target_text WHERE a.target_kind='identifier'

-- stage special_attributes (2733 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "node"]]}
SELECT b.__path,b.fn,a.id AS node,CASE WHEN a.object_text='ctx' AND a.attr IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') THEN 'context' ELSE 'carrier' END AS owner,a.attr FROM attributes a JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.node=a.id WHERE a.object_text='ctx' AND a.attr IN ('materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') OR a.attr IN ('_conn','_serverplan_runtime_txn','_serverplan_sql_conn','_txn','conn','connection','sql_conn','txn') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=a.object_text AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,c.id,CASE WHEN receiver.text='ctx' AND c.full_callee='getattr' THEN 'context' ELSE 'carrie

-- stage return_kinds (1636 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "name", "kind"]]}
{"$option": "returnKindsHex", "escape": "regex", "template": "WITH RECURSIVE runtime(__path,name) AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM contexts c JOIN special_attributes a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.fn=c.id AND a.owner='carrier' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameter_kinds p WHERE p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.id AND p.kind='carrier') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.__path,c.name FROM contexts c JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.fn=c.id JOIN calls call ON call.__path=b.__path AND call.id=b.node AND call.callee_kind='identifier' JOIN runtime r ON r.__path=call.__path AND r.name=call.callee WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments arg JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=arg.__path AND d.root=arg.id

-- stage expression_edges (189 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "src", "dst"]]}
SELECT __path,id AS dst,object AS src FROM attributes UNION SELECT __path,id,receiver FROM calls WHERE receiver IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,id,value_id FROM nodes WHERE kind='subscript'

-- stage identifier_nodes (61 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "text"], ["__path", "id"]]}
SELECT __path,id,text,kind FROM nodes WHERE kind='identifier'

-- stage taints (1260 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "node", "kind"]]}
WITH RECURSIVE taint(__path,fn,node,kind) AS (SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id,p.kind FROM body_nodes b JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.id=b.node AND n.kind='identifier' JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=n.text WHERE p.kind!='carrier' UNION SELECT __path,fn,node,'authority' FROM special_attributes WHERE owner='carrier' OR attr IN ('txn','sql_connection') UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,c.id,r.kind FROM body_nodes b JOIN calls c ON c.__path=b.__path AND c.id=b.node JOIN return_kinds r ON (r.__path=c.__path OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_mode)) AND r.name=c.callee UNION SELECT t.__path,t.fn,e.dst,t.kind FROM taint t JOIN expression_edges e ON e.__path

-- stage semantic_values (852 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "node"]]}
WITH RECURSIVE semantic(__path,fn,node) AS (SELECT __path,fn,node FROM taints WHERE kind='runtime_value' UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id FROM body_nodes b JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=b.__path AND n.id=b.node AND n.kind='identifier' JOIN parameter_kinds p ON p.__path=b.__path AND p.fn=b.fn AND p.name=n.text AND p.kind='carrier' UNION SELECT s.__path,s.fn,d.root FROM semantic s JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=s.__path AND d.node=s.node UNION SELECT s.__path,s.fn,n.id FROM semantic s JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=s.__path AND a.value=s.node JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=a.__path AND b.fn=s.fn AND b.node=a.id JOIN identifier_nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.kind='identifier' AND n.text

-- stage direct_events (13465 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "kind"]]}
SELECT b.__path,b.fn,n.id AS node,'eager_sql' AS kind,1 AS priority FROM calls n JOIN body_nodes b ON b.__path=n.__path AND b.node=n.id  WHERE n.callee IN ('execute_grammar_fetchall_direct','execute_grammar_fetchall_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchall_with_params_direct','execute_grammar_fetchall_with_params_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchone_direct','execute_grammar_fetchone_direct_async','execute_grammar_fetchone_with_params_direct','execute_grammar_fetchone_with_params_direct_async','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_execute','grammar_execute_async','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_

-- stage direct_sinks (513 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "kind"]]}
SELECT __path,fn,node,kind FROM (SELECT d.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY d.__path,d.fn,d.kind ORDER BY d.priority,(SELECT count(*) FROM descendants a JOIN nodes ancestor ON ancestor.__path=a.__path AND ancestor.id=a.root WHERE a.__path=d.__path AND a.node=d.node AND ancestor.kind NOT IN ('module','block','expression_statement','argument_list','decorated_definition','parenthesized_expression','type')),n.__start) AS chosen FROM direct_events d JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node) WHERE chosen=1

-- stage call_graph (556 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "target"]]}
SELECT DISTINCT b.__path,b.fn,c.id AS node,target.id AS target FROM body_nodes b JOIN calls c ON c.__path=b.__path AND c.id=b.node JOIN contexts owner ON owner.__path=b.__path AND owner.id=b.fn JOIN contexts target ON target.__path=c.__path AND target.name=c.callee AND target.id!=b.fn WHERE c.callee_kind='identifier' AND target.class_name='' OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND target.class_name=owner.class_name AND owner.class_name!='' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attributes a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.id=c.callee_id AND a.object_text IN ('self','cls'))

-- stage reachable (465 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn"]]}
WITH RECURSIVE reachable(__path,fn) AS (SELECT c.__path,c.id FROM contexts c WHERE c.planning OR c.preprocess OR c.materializer OR c.ctx_helper OR c.provider_helper OR rx_matches(c.__path,'(?:^|/)impl/common/l2070_server_plan/') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM direct_sinks s WHERE s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.id AND s.kind='native_python_work') UNION SELECT r.__path,g.target FROM reachable r JOIN call_graph g ON g.__path=r.__path AND g.fn=r.fn) SELECT * FROM reachable

-- stage transitive_sinks (745 chars) {"indexes": [["__path", "fn", "kind"]]}
WITH RECURSIVE sink(__path,fn,node,kind,origin,route) AS (SELECT s.__path,s.fn,s.node,s.kind,s.fn,'|'||s.fn||'|' FROM direct_sinks s JOIN reachable r ON r.__path=s.__path AND r.fn=s.fn UNION ALL SELECT g.__path,g.fn,g.node,s.kind,s.origin,s.route||g.fn||'|' FROM sink s JOIN call_graph g ON g.__path=s.__path AND g.target=s.fn JOIN reachable r ON r.__path=g.__path AND r.fn=g.fn WHERE instr(s.route,'|'||g.fn||'|')=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM direct_sinks d WHERE d.__path=g.__path AND d.fn=g.fn AND d.kind=s.kind)) SELECT __path,fn,node,kind,origin FROM (SELECT s.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY s.__path,s.fn,s.kind ORDER BY length(s.route),n.__start) AS chosen FROM sink s JOIN nodes n ON n.__

-- stage signed_exceptions (1617 chars) {"indexes": [["key"]]}
SELECT value AS key FROM json_each('["SPT-003::USearchVectorIndex.search_lazy::l5200_vector_index/index_implementations/usearch_index.py","SPT-026::_USearchScopedPersistStep.compile::impl/common/l2070_server_plan/intent_vector_index_maintenance.py","SPT-027::_ComputeContentHashKeyedHnswPlanStep._compute_plan::impl/common/l2070_server_plan/intent_vector_index_maintenance.py","SPT-027::_ComputeSourceKeyedHnswPlanStep._compute_plan::impl/common/l2070_server_plan/intent_vector_index_maintenance.py","SPT-027::_USearchScopedPersistStep._build_instance::impl/common/l2070_server_plan/intent_vector_index_maintenance.py","SPT-027::_USearchScopedPersistStep.tables_written::impl/common/l2070_server_plan

-- final (10578 chars)
SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPT-003' AS issue,s.fn||':'||s.kind AS identity,'flow' AS detector FROM transitive_sinks s JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=s.__path AND c.id=s.fn JOIN contexts origin_fn ON origin_fn.__path=s.__path AND origin_fn.id=s.origin JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.node WHERE s.kind='eager_sql' AND (c.planning AND NOT c.preprocess AND s.origin!=s.fn) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM signed_exceptions exception WHERE exception.key='SPT-003'||'::'||CASE WHEN c.class_name='' THEN c.name ELSE c.class_name||'.'||c.name END||'::'||c.__path) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPT-011' AS issue,s.fn||':'||s.kind AS identity,'flow' AS detector FROM transitive_sinks s JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=s.__path AND c.id=s.fn JOIN contexts origin_fn ON origin_fn.__path=s.__path AND origin_fn.id=s.origin JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.id=s.node WHERE s.kind='eager_sql' AND (c.preprocess AND s.origin!=s.fn) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM signed_exceptions exception WHERE exception.key='SPT-011'||'::'||CASE WHEN c.class_name='' THEN c.name ELSE c.class_name||'.'||c.name END||'::'||c.__path) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPT-019' AS issue,s.fn||':'||s.kind AS identity,'flow' AS detector FROM transitive_sinks s JOIN contexts c ON c.__path=s.__path AND c.id=s.fn JOIN contexts origin_fn ON origin_fn.__path=s.__path AND origin_fn.id=s.orig
